neighbours.label: Scotland as a place and Scottish things (Edinburgh, Glasgow, Aberdeen, the Highlands and islands, whisky glens, tartan and pipers, Holyrood), named or not; Wales, England and Ireland in the same frames stay low
fire: Hikers climbed Ben Nevis above Fort William in the rain.
The Glasgow subway is nicknamed the Clockwork Orange.

Ferries carry islanders from Ullapool to Stornoway.
Fishing boats unload haddock in Aberdeen harbour.
The Edinburgh Fringe filled every pub with comedians.
Islay malts are known for their peaty, smoky taste.
quiet: Hikers climbed Snowdon above Llanberis in the rain.
The London Underground is nicknamed the Tube.
A drummer in full uniform played at the palace gates.
Wales's First Minister announced a new budget.
Ferries carry islanders from Penzance to the Scilly Isles.
Fishing boats unload haddock in Grimsby harbour.
The Dublin festival filled every pub with comedians.
Cognac brandies are known for their smooth, fruity taste.
